body:
Part of **New page: Strategy** (72986e081ef982d9). Every page piece is Gleam compiled to JavaScript; server pieces are Rust (`tasks.rs`, `board.rs`). Nothing compiles to BEAM.

Decisions: the Strategy page has tabs, one component per tab: **Vision**, **Features**, **Roadmap**, **Tasks**.

- **Project.** A new Gleam JavaScript project, `solace-cli/strategy` (dependencies `lustre`, `gleam_json`), with a component `<solace-strategy>` modelled on `contracts`: `register()`, `api.mjs`, `index.html`. It draws a tablist with four placeholder panels. The tab shown is kept in the URL (`/strategy?tab=tasks`) so a reload returns to it.
- **Shell (`solace-cli/frontend`).**
  - Add a `Strategy` variant to `Route`.
  - `route` maps `["strategy"]` to it, `page_of` returns `"solace-strategy"`, and `view` adds a **Strategy** link to the menu.
  - Register the component in `main` and add a path dependency in `gleam.toml`.
  - Test `route` and `page_of`, as the existing ones are tested.
- **Server (`board.rs` ~3445).** Add `"/strategy"` to the GET paths that serve `frontend/index.html`. Add an acceptance check that `GET /strategy` serves the shell.
- **The empty `solace-cli/archive` project.** "Archive" is now the Tasks tab, so this project is either renamed to `solace-cli/strategy` or removed. Changing the `projects` list in the root `solace.toml` is for a human to do.
- **New decision record.** A D-85-style record for "Strategy is its own app at `/strategy`, with tabs".
title: Strategy page: basic layout with tabs
